texts.zh:
我们的[from.GetName]方舟在[from.solar_system.GetName]系中被摧毁了——不是被征服，而是被处决。

[fromfrom.GetName]根本不要什么领土或者朝贡，他们只要我们死。在将我们从星间灭绝的行动中，船上的每一条生命对他们而言都是可接受的伤亡数字。

但我们经历了这一切侥幸活了下来，我们绝不会被抹杀。
texts.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed - not through conquest, but through extermination.

[fromfrom.GetName] did not seek territory or tribute. They sought our end. Every soul aboard was an acceptable casualty in their campaign to purge us from the stars.

We survive. We endure. We will not be erased.

texts.zh:
我们的方舟舰[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中陷落——并非毁于那些畏惧未知的定居帝国之手，而是毁于与我们一样熟悉虚空的流浪者之手。

[fromfrom.GetName]向我们发动了攻击，明知摧毁一个民族最后的家园意味着什么。流浪者之间没有团结，只有生存。

我们不会忘记这一切。
texts.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] has been lost in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system - not to settled empires who fear what they do not understand, but to wanderers who know the void as we do.

[fromfrom.GetName] struck against us, knowing full well what it means to destroy a people's last home. There is no solidarity among wanderers. There is only survival.

We will not forget this.

texts.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的方舟舰[from.GetName]已被敌人摧毁。

战斗异常激烈，但敌人的力量势不可挡。尽管我们的船员英勇无畏，但我们的防御最终瓦解，方舟舰永远地离开了我们，它的残骸散落在太空中。

这一天将永远被铭记。
texts.en:
Our Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has been destroyed by the enemy.

The battle was fierce, but the strength of our foes proved overwhelming. Despite the valor of our crew, our defenses faltered, and the Arkship has been torn from us forever, its debris scattered through the void.

This day shall be remembered.

texts.zh: 一艘巨大的方舟战舰在战斗中被摧毁，留下了一片广阔的残骸。其基础设施、引擎和船体的残余可能为打捞提供有价值的材料。
texts.en: A colossal arkship has been destroyed in battle, leaving behind a vast field of wreckage. The remains of its infrastructure, engines, and hull may yield valuable materials for salvage.

texts.zh:
异星舰船[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系被歼灭。

游牧舰队进行了激烈抵抗，但终究不敌我方。那些在群星之间无序漂泊的流浪者始终是个威胁。他们的方舟舰已化作四散的残骸。

不要让他们任何一人找到安全港。
texts.en:
The alien vessel [from.GetName] has been eliminated from the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

The nomadic fleet resisted fiercely, but they were outmatched. Wanderers who drift between the stars without order are a persistent threat. Their Arkship has been reduced to scattered debris.

Let none of them find safe harbor.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[from.GetName]已在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中被摧毁。

在所有民族之中，我们最明白这样的舰船意味着什么——一个仅凭船体与引擎承载的文明，一代又一代都在同样的舱壁内生老病死。这份理解并未拯救他们。它也无能为力。

他们的漂泊到此为止。
texts.en:
The Arkship [from.GetName] has been destroyed in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We of all peoples understand what such a vessel represents - a civilization carried in hull and engine alone, each generation living and dying within the same walls. That understanding did not spare them. It could not.

Their wandering ends here.

texts.zh:
[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中的[from.GetName]方舟终于被摧毁了。

方舟不仅仅是一个战争的器具，它还是无数游牧生命体的家园。曾经生活和旅行于其中的几代人现在失去了维系他们的基础。

剩下的只有残骸，在虚空中悄无声息地漂流。
texts.en:
The Arkship [from.GetName] in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has at last been destroyed.

More than just a vessel of war, the Arkship was a home to countless nomadic lifeforms. Generations who once lived and traveled within have been left without the foundation that bound them together.

What remains is wreckage, drifting silently through the void.

summary.text:
# 方舟被毁的通知 / A Grievous Loss (arkship destroyed)

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 arkship.1020（on_ship_disabled，00_on_actions.txt:2055；nomads_arkship_events.txt:4953-5394）：方舟被击瘫时，若无来源舰船、攻击方与我交战、或攻击方是危机/守护者/太空生物/敌对者，则按攻击方类型分支。
Hidden arkship.1020 runs when an arkship is disabled (on_ship_disabled) and branches on the attacker.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 攻击方是灭绝者（homicidal）：方舟被毁，生成残骸；攻击方（常规国家）得到回收项目 ARKSHIP_DEBRIS（拾取时 arkship.1025 按方舟等级给 1000/2000/4000 合金）；双方通过隐藏事件 1010 / 1000 各收到一次性通知 arkship.1015（受害方）与 arkship.1005（攻击方），之后只有简讯。
  A homicidal attacker destroys the arkship; a wreck is created, the attacker gets the salvage project (1000/2000/4000 alloys by arkship tier); both sides get a once-only notice (1015 victim, 1005 attacker), later only toasts.
- 危机势力：同样击毁并留下残骸，但没有回收项目。 Crisis attackers destroy it without a salvage project.
- 无来源（如异常消失）：残骸与受害方通知。 No source: wreck and victim notice.
- 太空生物/守护者/敌对非交战者：方舟被击瘫后被迫撤到邻近星系，随后 arkship.1021 修复（后继无可读事件）。 Critters / guardians / hostile non-war attackers: the arkship is pushed to a neighbouring system and repaired by hidden 1021.
- 其他（常规交战国）：战争疲惫；视攻击方国策，可强征 25% 人口、屠杀 25% 人口或拆除区划；方舟被俘；游牧方可开始恢复项目 RECOVER_DISABLED_NOMAD_VESSEL（arkship.1027）。
  Otherwise (regular war): war exhaustion and, by the attacker's policy, relocate 25% of pops, purge 25% or strip districts; the arkship is captured; a nomad owner is offered a recovery project (1027).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 通知文本按攻击方是否灭绝者、是否游牧而变（arkship.1005 / 1015 各三种）。 Notice texts vary by attacker type.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 受害方通知 1015 的三个选项互斥：灭绝者 / 游牧 / 其他。 The three options of 1015 are exclusive by attacker type.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt, common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt
- 已核对 Checked：1000/1005/1010/1015/1020/1021/1022/1025/1026/1027 的触发（nomads_arkship_events.txt:4708-5600）。
- 局限 Scope：被劫掠分支（国策 arkship_raid_*）与恢复项目只作概述，没有可读事件文本；故事内的三个文档并列，因为它们是同一次击毁从不同视角看到的结果。
  The three docs are parallel: the same destruction seen from the victim, the attacker and the wreck.
- 说明 Note：该故事的入口由隐藏路由决定，没有玩家可见的起点。 The entry is a hidden router.
